description.tr: Winchester Mystery House, garip mimarisi ve efsanevi hikayeleriyle ünlüdür. Ziyaretçiler, binanın labirent gibi odalarını keşfederken, evin tarihine dair ilginç bilgiler edinebilirler.
description.en: The Winchester Mystery House is famous for its strange architecture and legendary stories. Visitors can explore the maze-like rooms of the house and learn fascinating facts about its history.
description.de: Das Winchester Mystery House ist berühmt für seine seltsame Architektur und legendären Geschichten. Besucher können die labyrinthartigen Räume des Hauses erkunden und interessante Fakten über seine Geschichte erfahren.

description.tr: Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum, Eski Mısır medeniyetine ait birçok eseri barındıran bir müzedir. Ziyaretçiler, mumyaları, heykelleri ve diğer antik eserleri görebilirler.
description.en: The Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum houses many artifacts from ancient Egyptian civilization. Visitors can see mummies, statues, and other ancient items.
description.de: Das Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum beherbergt viele Artefakte aus der alten ägyptischen Zivilisation. Besucher können Mumien, Statuen und andere antike Gegenstände sehen.
